The '''Azure Defense Fleet''' was the fleet stationed on the planet [[Azure/Legends|Azure]], led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Solomahal/Legends|Solomahal]]. It consisted of a small amount of starfighters and other vessels.

==History==
The most well-known of the fleet's actions was at the [[Battle of Azure Spaceport]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Here, they attempted to hold off a massive droid fleet with the help of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to protect a vital machine called a codebreaker, developed by [[Talesan Fry]], that could listen in on enemy communication. They suffered casualties and were forced into a retreat, but the group was not eliminated entirely nor disbanded.<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi">[[Secrets of the Jedi (novel)|''Secrets of the Jedi'']]</ref>

==Ships and vessels==
The fleet consisted of planetary starships and a handful of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], which were stationed specifically because of the tiny planet's stealth and unimportance in the war. Many of them were lost in the Azure battle, but some of their best pilots managed to survive the fight under the leadership of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] Skywalker and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Banno]].<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi" />

==Known members==
Among the pilots or leaders known to have fought in the fleet were [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Banno]] and [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]] General Solomahal.<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi" />
